name: Cinder Automata
summary: Cinder Automata is a fast-paced factory-building tower defense and roguelite set in an ember-lit sci-fi wasteland. As rogue, corroded machines march on your Cinder Core, survival depends on rapid automation: mine raw ore, build conveyor logistics, wire up power grids, assemble advanced ammunition, and fabricate autonomous robot armies. Distilling the depth of automation games into focused 3-to-10-minute wave-defense runs, every belt, smelter, and turret exists for one purpose: to hold the line.
